name: career-consultant
description: Personal career consultant: sets job-search strategy, analyzes the market with requirement frequencies, scores vacancies on SKILLS ONLY (conditions are non-blocking flags, for a wide funnel) with a weighted breakdown + confidence + evidence map, reviews resumes for market-fit and ATS, rewrites bullets truthfully (three-layer, Master read-only), drafts tight cover letters, tracks applications, and learns from rejections.
